scenes.line1: Why do some models underfit or overfit?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why your model is too simple or too complex? Let's break down the bias-variance trade-off and how regularization helps.
High bias means your model is too simple and misses real patterns. High variance means it's too complex and memorizes noise. You want a balance.

scenes.label: Regularize
scenes.sub: L1 and L2 regularization penalize complexity
scenes.say: Regularization like L1 or L2 adds a penalty for complexity. This keeps your model from overfitting.

scenes.title: Lasso Regression
scenes.say: Lasso regression, which uses L1 regularization, can even shrink some coefficients to zero and simplify your model.

scenes.question: How do you spot overfitting fast?
scenes.right: Compare training and validation errors. Overfitting shows low training error but high validation error.
scenes.say: Don't just look at training error. Always compare training and validation errors. Overfitting shows up as low training error but high validation error.
